reverse a decision: After hundreds of parents complained, the school board agreed to reverse a decision that had banned phones on campus.
在數百位家長抱怨之後，學校董事會同意推翻先前禁止在校園使用手機的決定。
reverse the trend: Birth rates keep falling, and the government hopes new childcare subsidies can reverse the trend so more couples have children again.
出生率持續下降，政府希望新的育兒補助能扭轉趨勢，讓更多夫妻再次願意生小孩。
reverse the car: There was no space to turn around, so Dad had to reverse the car slowly out of the narrow alley.
沒有空間可以迴轉，所以爸爸只好慢慢倒車，把車退出那條窄巷。
reverse roles: In today's activity, students and teachers will reverse roles, so the kids get to plan and teach the lesson.
在今天的活動中，學生和老師將角色互換，讓孩子們來規劃並教授這堂課。
reverse the damage: Doctors say that quitting smoking early can help reverse the damage to your lungs within a few years.
醫生說，及早戒菸可以在幾年內幫助逆轉肺部所受的損害。
reverse the charges: My phone had no credit, so I called my parents from a pay phone and asked the operator to reverse the charges.
我的手機沒有儲值了，所以我用公共電話打給爸媽，並請接線生改由對方付費。
review the situation: Before deciding whether to cancel the outdoor concert, the organizers will review the situation again tomorrow morning.
在決定是否取消戶外演唱會之前，主辦單位明天早上會再次檢討情況。
review a book: Our English teacher asked each of us to review a book we enjoyed and share our opinions with the class.
我們的英文老師要我們每個人評論一本自己喜歡的書，並和全班分享看法。
review for an exam: I spent the whole weekend at the library to review for an exam that counts for half of my grade.
我整個週末都待在圖書館複習備考，因為這次考試占了我成績的一半。
review the evidence: The judge needed more time to review the evidence carefully before announcing whether the man was guilty.
法官需要更多時間仔細審查證據，才能宣布那名男子是否有罪。
under review: The new school uniform design is still under review, so students will not see the final version until March.
新校服的設計仍在審查中，所以學生要到三月才能看到最終版本。
review one's options: After failing to get into her dream university, Amy sat down with her parents to review her options for next year.
沒能考上夢想中的大學後，Amy 和父母坐下來重新考慮明年的各種選項。
revise a plan: When the typhoon warning was issued, our class had to revise a plan we had made for the trip to Kenting.
颱風警報發布後，我們班只好修改原本為墾丁旅行訂好的計畫。
revise one's opinion: After talking with the new neighbor in person, Grandma had to revise her opinion of him because he was actually very kind.
親自和新鄰居聊過之後，奶奶不得不改變對他的看法，因為他其實非常親切。
revise for exams: Many students in Britain take a week off school in June to revise for exams at home.
許多英國學生在六月請一週假，在家複習備考。
revise figures upward: Because sales were much better than expected, the company decided to revise figures upward in its yearly report.
由於銷售遠比預期好，公司決定在年度報告中向上修正數字。
revise the schedule: Because two teachers were sick, the school had to revise the schedule for next week's classes.
因為有兩位老師生病，學校只好調整下週課程的時間表。
revive the economy: The government plans to build new railways and lower taxes to revive the economy after the long recession.
政府計畫興建新鐵路並降低稅率，以便在長期衰退後振興經濟。
revive interest: The museum's new interactive exhibits helped revive interest in local history among young people.
博物館新的互動式展覽幫助年輕人重燃對地方歷史的興趣。
revive a tradition: Our village decided to revive a tradition of lantern making that had been forgotten for fifty years.
我們村子決定復興一項被遺忘了五十年的製作燈籠傳統。
revive a patient: The nurse used a special machine to revive a patient whose heart had suddenly stopped beating.
護理師用一台特殊的機器救醒了一位心臟突然停止跳動的病人。
revive memories: The smell of my grandmother's soup can suddenly revive memories of my childhood that I thought I had forgotten.
奶奶煮的湯的香味會突然喚起我以為早已忘記的童年回憶。
revive hopes: A surprise win last night helped revive hopes among fans that the team could still reach the finals.
昨晚一場意外的勝利讓球迷重燃希望，覺得球隊仍有機會打進決賽。
revolve around money: For some people, everything seems to revolve around money, and they rarely think about friendship or happiness.
對某些人來說，一切似乎都以錢為中心，他們很少想到友誼或快樂。
the earth revolves: Day and night happen because the earth revolves on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
白天和黑夜之所以產生，是因為地球自轉，每二十四小時轉一圈。
life revolves around work: Since he became a manager, his life revolves around work, and he rarely has time for his family.
自從他當上經理後，生活就圍繞工作打轉，很少有時間陪家人。
the debate revolves around: In today's class meeting, the debate revolves around whether students should be allowed to use phones during lunch.
在今天的班會中，辯論圍繞著學生是否應該被允許在午餐時間使用手機。
reward hard work: Our coach believes in fairness, so he always tries to reward hard work rather than natural talent.
我們教練重視公平，所以他總是努力獎勵努力，而不是天生的才能。
be rewarded with: After climbing for six hours in the dark, the hikers were rewarded with a breathtaking view of the sunrise.
在黑暗中爬了六個小時後，登山客獲得令人屏息的日出美景作為回報。
reward loyalty: The coffee shop gives free drinks to its regular customers because it wants to reward loyalty.
這家咖啡店送免費飲料給常客，因為它想獎勵顧客的忠誠。
a rewarding experience: Volunteering at the animal shelter last summer was a rewarding experience that taught me patience and responsibility.
去年夏天在動物收容所當志工是一次有收穫的經驗，讓我學會了耐心與責任感。
